newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Norsk Hydro agrees Czech Skoda supply deal.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro agrees Czech Skoda supply deal.

text.p: Czech engineering concern Skoda a.s. signed a framework agreement on Wednesday to supply drilling, power generating and other machinery to Norway's Norsk Hydro ASA, Skoda chairman and general director Lubomir Soudek said.
The framework deal sets up negotiations on separate contracts for each supply deal.

"The cooperation would be in supplies for Norsk Hydro's petrochemical and drilling installations, and supplies for their production facilities," Soudek told reporters after a signing cermony. "We would want the yearly turnover to be at least one billion crowns."
Soudek said that the supplies would include steam turbines and diesel generators, and that the two companies would also cooperate in materials development.
Soudek said the agreement also provided the framework for setting up a joint venture between the two companies in the Czech Republic for production of aluminium cabs for Skoda-made utility trucks.

The contract was signed at a business forum in Prague where Czech Industry and Trade Minister Vladimir Dlouhy earlier had announced that the Czech Republic and Norway finalised a long-term deal for purchase of natural gas.
Norsk Hydro is a member of Norway's gas negotiating union GFU which arranged the gas contract.
